literal: Even if the cosmic aeon shifts, they themselves will not swerve, those who are called the ocean for perfect character.
translation: Those who are hailed as the ocean of perfect character will never swerve from their virtue, even if the cosmic aeon itself should change.
modern: உலகம் அழியும் ஊழிக்காலம் மாறினாலும், சான்றாண்மைக்குக் கடல் போன்றவர் என்று சொல்லப்படுபவர்கள் தம் நற்பண்பிலிருந்து மாற மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the unshakeable integrity of truly noble individuals. The poet compares them to the ocean (ஆழி), which is traditionally seen as a symbol of stability that never transgresses its boundaries. Even during the cataclysmic end of an aeon (ஊழி) when the entire universe undergoes drastic shifts, these exemplary people will not swerve from their high moral standards. Their character remains constant regardless of how much the world around them changes.
